data.case_title: Order banning residential use of the garden house (Ordnungsverfügung)
data.title: Order banning residential use of the garden house (Ordnungsverfügung)
data.summary: The City of Musterhagen's building authority (Untere Bauaufsichtsbehörde) has issued a formal order banning the residential use of the garden house at Zechenweg 3, requiring it to be given up by 30 November 2027. If this deadline is missed, the city has announced a coercive fine (Zwangsgeld) of €1,500.
data.explanation: The city's building authority found during a site visit that your garden house is being permanently lived in without the building permit required for residential use, and has formally banned this use. You must stop living in the garden house by 30 November 2027; missing this can trigger a coercive fine (Zwangsgeld) of €1,500. You may instead file a court action (Klage) with the administrative court if you disagree with the order — a Widerspruch is not available here. The app will show you the exact deadline for that court action. Given the legal and financial consequences, consulting a lawyer may be worthwhile.

remedy.quote: Die Klage ist binnen eines Monats nach der Bekanntgabe dieser Verfügung beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterkirchen, Justizplatz 1, 45879 Musterkirchen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle einzureichen; ein Widerspruchsverfahren ist nach § 110 JustG NRW ausgeschlossen.

items.title: End the residential use of the garden house
items.action: Completely stop living in the garden house by the stated date.
items.consequence: The city has announced it will impose a coercive fine (Zwangsgeld) of €1,500 if you do not comply.
items.quote: Die Wohnnutzung ist bis zum 30.11.2027 vollständig aufzugeben.

items.title: Decide whether to file a court action (Klage) against this order
items.action: Decide whether to challenge this order by filing a court action (Klage) with the Verwaltungsgericht Musterkirchen; the app shows the deadline.
items.consequence: If no court action is filed in time, the order becomes final and binding.
